name: 32703 · Apopka, FL
findings: ZIP 32703 (Apopka) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32703 (Apopka) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32703 (Apopka) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
